summary: Tested 3 NEW wizard form conversions: InvestmentForm (4-step), LoanForm (4-step), and InsuranceForm (4-step). All forms use WizardShell.js component correctly with step indicators, per-step validation, Next/Back navigation, and Save button on final step.
critical_code_review_comments: All 3 forms correctly use WizardShell component with 4 steps each
Step content implemented as plain JSX variables (step1Content, step2Content, etc.) - prevents React remounting issues
Per-step validation works correctly - errors shown when clicking Next without required fields
Save button appears only on Step 4 (final step), Next button hidden on final step
Header back button correctly navigates to previous step when step > 1
InvestmentForm: Loan Given category shows special fields (borrower name, contact, interest type, repayment type)
LoanForm: EMI auto-calculates from principal, interest rate, and tenure
InsuranceForm: Life Insurance shows covered person, maturity type, premium payment term fields
seed_data_creation: None - tested wizard UI only without saving
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 wizard forms (Investment, Loan, Insurance) fully tested. Each has 4 steps with proper validation, navigation, and Save button on final step. Edit mode shows all fields at once (editModeContent). WizardShell.js provides shared header, step indicator, and sticky bottom buttons.
